summary.text: Brad Tabke is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 54A, in office since 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Republican Aaron Paul is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Brad Tabke lives in Shakopee, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. in horticulture from Iowa State University in 2001.

His career experience includes founding Grepoli LLC and Ethical Landscape Consultants LLC, working as vice president of sales for Reliable Property Services, and working as vice president of operations for Outdoor Environments.
Tabke served as chairman of the board of the Shakopee Area Chamber of Commerce and as mayor of the City of Shakopee.
He previously represented Minnesota House District 55A from 2019 to 2021.
Brad Tabke defeated Republican Aaron Paul in the November 5, 2024 general election.

Tabke's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy Committee, the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy Committee and the House Transportation Finance and Policy Committee.
